verdict.rationale: Khoj's own docs say it can generate and run simple Python code, for example to do data analysis or produce plots and reports. That is a real, if narrow, execution surface rather than just chat. Nothing in the evidence shows it running shell commands or editing files on the user's machine. missing for 10: shell/command execution on the host machine, file create/edit capability, documentation that execution happens on the user's machine rather than in an isolated runtime, independent or hands-on corroboration of the exec feature
